description.silhouette: Square stone plinth, 0.70 m, filling the free deck of one fort cell under a turret
description.colors: Weathered grey field stone matching the fort's thresholds, dark mortar, a dark iron anchor plate, moss in the joints
description.anatomy: Strict orthographic top-down. Four dressed slabs with chamfered edges and open joints over a mortar core, a central iron anchor plate with bolts and the post socket. Broad values stay readable at 22 px.
